title: Input events
description: One input event or a list of them, in order, as `Chart::input` folds them into the view state (REQ-INPUT-010, REQ-INPUT-020). The JSON form is canonical: tests, the contract, the CLI's scripted input and recorded sessions use it. The browser crosses the boundary with a numeric encoding of the same fields (`input(kind, x, y, a, b, buttons, mods, t)` returning a bitmask), so the hot path builds no strings. Positions are in cells from the drawn grid's top-left, with fractions inside a cell (the terminal sends 0.5, a cell's centre); they may fall outside the grid while a drag is captured. `t` is play time in seconds, used only to stamp `motion`; the reducer reads no clock.

x.description: Column in cells, with a fraction inside the cell.

y.description: Row in cells, with a fraction inside the cell.

mods.description: Modifier keys held: a subset of shift, ctrl, alt, meta. Default none.

end.description: True on the gesture's last event.

pointer.description: move, down or up: from pointermove, pointerdown and pointerup, or crossterm's Moved, Drag, Down and Up.
The pointer's type, as PointerEvent.pointerType; default mouse.

buttons.description: Buttons held, as PointerEvent.buttons (1 primary, 2 secondary, 4 middle); default 0.

leave.description: The pointer left the chart or the chart lost focus (pointerleave, blur).

wheel.description: Wheel deltas summed over one animation frame (pixels ÷ line height), or a terminal scroll of ±1.

x.description: Column of the pointer in cells.

y.description: Row of the pointer in cells.

dy.description: Vertical delta in lines; negative is up.

mods.description: Modifier keys held; ctrl or meta makes the wheel zoom (REQ-INPUT-040).

pinch.description: A two-pointer pinch, from the shell's recogniser or a trackpad.

x.description: Column of the pinch's centre in cells.

y.description: Row of the pinch's centre in cells.

scale.description: The change in spread since the last pinch event; above 1 zooms in.

end.description: True on the pinch's last event.

pan.description: A two-finger pan, from the shell's recogniser.

dx.description: Horizontal movement in cells since the last pan event.

dy.description: Vertical movement in cells since the last pan event.

end.description: True on the pan's last event, when the fingers lift.

velocity.description: Horizontal velocity in cells a second at the end, which starts a kinetic motion.

tap.description: A tap or double tap, from the shell's recogniser (5 px slop, 500 ms between taps).

count.description: 1 for a tap, 2 for a double tap (which resets the view); default 1.

pointer.description: The pointer that tapped, as PointerEvent.pointerType, so a double-click's reset names the mouse; default mouse.

press.description: A long press, which starts a brush on touch (REQ-TOUCH-010).

key.description: A key pressed while the chart has focus: keydown, or crossterm's KeyEvent.
